title: Pluh
blurb: Conversation over. Thought complete. Nothing further to add, ever. A cat gets the credit for this tiny absurdist syllable, as cats generally do, and somewhere in the brainrot era it grew into a whole communication style: full stop, shrug and exit in one breath. It commits to nothing and means nothing, so nobody can argue with it, which leaves it perfectly suited to a message you have read and have no intention of engaging with. Send it as agreement. Send it as dismissal. Pluh.
origin: The viral 'pluh' cat clip, the internet's conversation-ending syllable.
